info.title: Gerrit Code Owners Plugin REST API
info.description: REST endpoints contributed by the code-owners plugin. Paths, parameters and payload schemas are generated statically from the plugin's REST bindings; human-authored summaries, descriptions and examples are mined from the plugin's rest-api.md and merged in at build time.

get.description: Gets the code owner project configuration.

_account_id.description: The numeric ID of the account.

name.description: The full name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

display_name.description: The display name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

email.description: The email address the user prefers to be contacted through. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and options DETAILS and ALL_EMAILS for account queries.

secondary_emails.description: A list of the secondary email addresses of the user. + Only set for account queries when the ALL_EMAILS option or the suggest parameter is set. + Secondary emails are only included if the calling user has the Modify Account, and hence is allowed to see secondary emails of other users.

username.description: The username of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

avatars.description: List of AvatarInfo + entities that provide information about avatar images of the account.

_more_accounts.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last account that is returned.

deleted.description: Whether the account is deleted. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

tags.description: List of additional tags that this account has. The only + current tag an account can have is SERVICE_USER. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

url.description: The URL to the avatar image.

height.description: The height of the avatar image in pixels.

id.description: ID of the code owner backend that is configured for the project.

ids_by_branch.description: IDs of the code owner backends that are configured for individual branches as map of full branch names to code owner backend IDs. Only contains entries for branches for which a code owner backend is configured that differs from the backend that is configured for the project (see id field).

path.description: Glob that limits the validation to code owner config files that have a path that matches this glob. By default unset, which means that all modified code owner config files should be validated.

verbosity.description: Level that controls which code owner config file issues are returned. The following values are supported: FATAL - only fatal issues are returned, ERROR - only fatal and error issues are returned, WARNING - all issues (warning, error and fatal) are returned. If unset, WARNING is used.

validate_disabled_branches.description: Whether code owner config files in branches for which the code owners functionality is disabled should be validated too. By default unset, false.

branches.description: List of branches for which code owner config files should be validated. The refs/heads/ prefix may be omitted. By default unset, which means that code owner config files in all branches should be validated.

path.description: Glob that limits the validation to code owner config files that have a path that matches this glob. By default unset, which means that all code owner config files should be validated.

verbosity.description: Level that controls which code owner config file issues are returned. The following values are supported: FATAL - only fatal issues are returned, ERROR - only fatal and error issues are returned, WARNING - all issues (warning, error and fatal) are returned. If unset, WARNING is used.

code_owner_config_file_info.description: The code owner config file as a CodeOwnerConfigFileInfo entity.

assigns_code_ownership_to_user.description: Whether this code owner config file assigns code ownership to the specified email and path. Note that if code ownership is assigned to the email via a code owner config file, but the email is not resolvable (see the is_resolvable field in CodeOwnerCheckInfo), the user is not a code owner.

are_parent_code_owners_ignored.description: Whether code owners from parent directory are ignored.

are_folder_code_owners_ignored.description: Whether folder code owners are ignored (i.e. whether there is a matching per-file rule that ignores folder code owners, e.g. by using "set noparent").

general.description: The general code owners configuration as GeneralInfo entity. Not set if disabled is true.

disabled.description: Whether the code owners functionality is disabled for the branch. If true the code owners API is disabled and submitting changes doesn't require code owner approvals. Not set if false.

backend_id.description: ID of the code owner backend that is configured for the branch. Not set if disabled is true.

required_approval.description: The approval that is required from code owners to approve the files in a change as RequiredApprovalInfo entity. The required approval defines which approval counts as code owner approval. Any approval on this label with a value >= the given value is considered as code owner approval.

override_approval.description: Approvals that count as override for the code owners submit check as a list of RequiredApprovalInfo entities (sorted alphabetically). If multiple approvals are returned, any of them is sufficient to override the code owners submit check.

is_code_owner.description: Whether the given email owns the specified path in the branch.

is_resolvable.description: Whether the given email is resolvable for the specified user or the calling user if no user was specified.

checked_code_owner_configs.description: The code owner config files that have been inspected to check the code owner with check results as CheckedCodeOwnerConfigFileInfo entities.

can_read_ref.description: Whether the user to which the given email was resolved has read permissions on the branch. Not set if the given email is not resolvable or if the given email is the all users wildcard (aka '*').

can_see_change.description: Whether the user to which the given email was resolved can see the specified change. Not set if the given email is not resolvable, if the given email is the all users wildcard (aka '*') or if no change was specified.

can_approve_change.description: Whether the user to which the given email was resolved can code-owner approve the specified change. Being able to code-owner approve the change means that the user has permissions to vote on the label that is required as code owner approval.

is_fallback_code_owner.description: Whether the given email is a fallback code owner of the specified path in the branch.

is_default_code_owner.description: Whether the given email is configured as a default code owner in the code owner config file in refs/meta/config. Note that if the email is configured as default code owner, but the email is not resolvable (see is_resolvable field), the user is not a code owner.

is_global_code_owner.description: Whether the given email is configured as a global code owner. Note that if the email is configured as global code owner, but the email is not resolvable (see is_resolvable field), the user is not a code owner.

is_owned_by_all_users.description: Whether the the specified path in the branch is owned by all users (aka *).

annotations.description: Annotations that were set for the user. Contains only supported annotations (unsupported annotations are reported in the debugs_logs). Sorted alphabetically.

debug_logs.description: List of debug logs that may help to understand why the user is or isn't a code owner. Full debug logs are only returned for callers that have the Check Code Owner or the Administrate Server global capability, for other callers the debug logs are limited.

project.description: The name of the project from which the code owner config was loaded, or for unresolved imports, from which the code owner config was supposed to be loaded.

branch.description: The name of the branch from which the code owner config was loaded, or for unresolved imports, from which the code owner config was supposed to be loaded.

path.description: The absolute path of the code owner config file.

web_links.description: Links to the code owner config file in external sites as a list of WebLinkInfo entities. Not set if the CodeOwnerConfigFileInfo represents an imported code owner config file that couldn't be resolved or if web links are not configured.

imports.description: Imported code owner config files as CodeOwnerConfigFileInfo entities.

unresolved_imports.description: Imported code owner config files that couldn't be resolved as CodeOwnerConfigFileInfo entities.

unresolved_error_message.description: Message explaining why this code owner config couldn't be resolved. Only set if the CodeOwnerConfigFileInfo represents an imported code owner config file that couldn't be resolved.

import_mode.description: The import mode (ALL or GLOBAL_CODE_OWNER_SETS_ONLY). Only set if the CodeOwnerConfigFileInfo represents an imported code owner config file.

account.description: The account of the code owner as an AccountInfo entity. At the moment the account field is always set, but it's marked as optional as in the future we may also return groups as code owner and then the account field would be unset.

scorings.description: Score name to scoring value map, that contains the scorings that were taken into account when computing the score of the listed code owner. Note that the returned values are not weighted.

general.description: The general code owners configuration as GeneralInfo entity. Not set if status.disabled is true.

status.description: The code owner status configuration as CodeOwnersStatusInfo entity. Contains information about whether the code owners functionality is disabled for the project or for any branch.

backend.description: The code owner backend configuration as BackendInfo entity. Not set if status.disabled is true.

required_approval.description: The approval that is required from code owners to approve the files in a change as RequiredApprovalInfo entity. The required approval defines which approval counts as code owner approval. Not set if status.disabled is true.

override_approval.description: Approvals that count as override for the code owners submit check as a list of RequiredApprovalInfo entities. If multiple approvals are returned, any of them is sufficient to override the code owners submit check. All returned override approvals are guarenteed to have distinct label names.

disabled.description: Whether the code owners functionality should be disabled/enabled for the project.

disabled_branches.description: List of branches for which the code owners functionality is disabled. Can be exact refs, ref patterns or regular expressions. Overrides any existing disabled branch configuration.

file_extension.description: The file extension that should be used for code owner config files in this project.

required_approval.description: The approval that is required from code owners. Must be specified in the format "\<label-name\>+\<label-value\>". If an empty string is provided the required approval configuration is unset.

override_approvals.description: The approvals that count as override for the code owners submit check. Must be specified in the format "\<label-name\>+\<label-value\>".

fallback_code_owners.description: Policy that controls who should own paths that have no code owners defined. Possible values are: NONE: Paths for which no code owners are defined are owned by no one. ALL_USERS: Paths for which no code owners are defined are owned by all users.

global_code_owners.description: List of emails of users that should be code owners globally across all branches.

exempted_users.description: List of emails of users that should be exempted from requiring code owners approvals.

merge_commit_strategy.description: Strategy that defines for merge commits which files require code owner approvals. Can be ALL_CHANGED_FILES or FILES_WITH_CONFLICT_RESOLUTION (see mergeCommitStrategy for an explanation of these values).

implicit_approvals.description: Whether an implicit code owner approval from the last uploader is assumed.

override_info_url.description: URL for a page that provides project/host-specific information about how to request a code owner override.

invalid_code_owner_config_info_url.description: URL for a page that provides project/host-specific information about how to deal with invalid code owner config files.

read_only.description: Whether code owner config files are read-only.

exempt_pure_reverts.description: Whether pure revert changes are exempted from needing code owner approvals for submit.

enable_validation_on_branch_creation.description: Policy for validating code owner config files when a branch is created.

enable_validation_on_commit_received.description: Policy for validating code owner config files when a commit is received.

enable_validation_on_submit.description: Policy for validating code owner config files when a change is submitted.

reject_non_resolvable_code_owners.description: Whether modifications of code owner config files that newly add non-resolvable code owners should be rejected on commit received and submit.

reject_non_resolvable_imports.description: Whether modifications of code owner config files that newly add non-resolvable imports should be rejected on commit received an submit.

max_paths_in_change_messages.description: The maximum number of paths that are included in change messages. Setting the value to 0 disables including owned paths into change messages.

patch_set_number.description: The number of the patch set for which the code owner statuses are returned.

file_code_owner_statuses.description: List of the code owner statuses for the files in the change as FileCodeOwnerStatusInfo entities, sorted by new path, then old path.

more.description: Whether the request would deliver more results if not limited. Not set if false.

accounts.description: An account ID to detailed AccountInfo entities map that contains the accounts that are referenced in the reason messages that are returned with the PathCodeOwnerStatusInfo entities in the file_code_owner_statuses. Not set if no accounts are referenced from reasons.

code_owners.description: List of code owners as CodeOwnerInfo entities. The code owners are sorted by a score that is computed from mutliple scoring factors.

owned_by_all_users.description: Whether the path is owned by all users. Not set if false.

code_owner_configs.description: The code owner config files that have been inspected to gather the code owners as CodeOwnerConfigFileInfo entities.

debug_logs.description: Debug logs that may help to understand why a user is or isn't suggested as a code owner. Only set if requested via --debug. This information is purely for debugging and the output may be changed at any time. This means bot callers must not parse the debug logs.

disabled.description: Whether the code owners functionality is disabled for the project. If true the code owners API is disabled and submitting changes doesn't require code owner approvals. Not set if false.

disabled_branches.description: Branches for which the code owners functionality is disabled. Configurations for non-existing and non-visible branches are omitted. Not set if the disabled field is true or if no branch specific status configuration is returned.

commit.description: The commit ID. Not set if included in a RevisionInfo entity that is contained in a map which has the commit ID as key.

parents.description: The parent commits of this commit as a list of CommitInfo entities. In each parent only the commit and subject fields are populated.

author.description: The author of the commit as a GitPersonInfo entity.

committer.description: The committer of the commit as a GitPersonInfo entity.

subject.description: The subject of the commit (header line of the commit message).

web_links.description: Links to the patch set in external sites as a list of WebLinkInfo entities.

resolve_conflicts_web_links.description: Links to the commit in external sites for resolving conflicts as a list of WebLinkInfo entities.

status.description: The status of the consistency problem. + Possible values are FATAL, ERROR and WARNING.

change_type.description: The type of the file modification. Can be ADDED, MODIFIED, DELETED, RENAMED or COPIED. Not set if MODIFIED.

old_path_status.description: The code owner status for the old path as PathCodeOwnerStatusInfo entity. Only set if change_type is DELETED or RENAMED.

new_path_status.description: The code owner status for the new path as PathCodeOwnerStatusInfo entity. Not set if change_type is DELETED.

file_extension.description: The file extension that is used for the code owner config files in this project. Not set if no file extension is used.

merge_commit_strategy.description: Strategy that defines for merge commits which files require code owner approvals. Can be ALL_CHANGED_FILES or FILES_WITH_CONFLICT_RESOLUTION (see mergeCommitStrategy for an explanation of these values).

implicit_approvals.description: Whether an implicit code owner approval from the last uploader is assumed (see enableImplicitApprovals for details). When unset, false.

override_info_url.description: Optional URL for a page that provides project/host-specific information about how to request a code owner override.

invalid_code_owner_config_info_url.description: Optional URL for a page that provides project/host-specific information about how to deal with invalid code owner config files.

fallback_code_owners.description: Policy that controls who should own paths that have no code owners defined. Possible values are: NONE: Paths for which no code owners are defined are owned by no one. ALL_USERS: Paths for which no code owners are defined are owned by all users.

email.description: The email address of the author/committer.

date.description: The timestamp of when this identity was constructed.

tz.description: The timezone offset from UTC of when this identity was constructed.

new_path.description: Owner information for the new path as a OwnedPathInfo entity. Not set for deletions.

old_path.description: Owner information for the old path as a OwnedPathInfo entity. Only set for deletions and renames.

owned.description: true is the path is owned by the user. Otherwise unset.

owners.description: List of owners for this file that are either the specified user or the reviewers if check_reviewers is passed to the request.

owned_changed_files.description: List of files that were changed in the revision for which the user owns the new path, the old path or both paths. The entries are sorted alphabetically by new path, and by old path if new path is not present. Contains at most as many entries as the limit that was specified on the request.

more.description: Whether the request would deliver more results if not limited. Not set if false.

path.description: The path to which the code owner status applies.

status.description: The code owner status for the path.

reasons.description: A list of reasons explaining the status. The reasons may contain placeholders for accounts as <GERRIT_ACCOUNT_XXXXXXX> (where XXXXXXX is the account ID). The referenced accounts are returned in the CodeOwnerStatusInfo entity that contains this PathCodeOwnerStatusInfo (see field accounts).

message.description: Commit message that should be used for the commit that renames the email in the code owner config files. If not set the following default commit message is used: "Rename email in code owner config files"

old_email.description: The old email that should be replaced with the new email.

new_email.description: The new email that should be used to replace the old email.

commit.description: The commit that did the email rename. Not set, if no update was necessary.

label.description: The name of label on which an approval is required.

value.description: The voting value that is required on the label.

tooltip.description: Tooltip to show when hovering over the link. Using "Open in $NAME_OF_EXTERNAL_TOOL" is a good option here.

image_url.description: URL to the icon of the link.

basicAuth.description: HTTP basic auth with a username and a generated HTTP password.
